driverRegime.method: daily % change of each asset regressed on the daily change in the US 2-year and 10-year yields (basis points) and on the daily % change in WTI; a driver is dominant when |corr| >= 0.4

dataNotes: Run timing: this cycle ran the morning of 28 October 2026 after the GitHub Actions fetch job drafted contracts/*.2026-10-27.json from Tuesday 27 October's close. Every figure used is dated at or before 2026-10-27; news-log entries dated 28 October (Fed decision, Saudi refinery attack, SK Hynix) were NOT used.

Bonds, dollar and IWM sigma are not auto-fetched; the last obtainable implied-volatility values (TLT 30-day IV, EUR/USD 1-month ATM IV, RVX) were carried forward again with their original stale-source notes, since no newer print was obtainable.

News-log entries for 2026-10-27 (five, identical in the news database and data/news_log.json; no hand-entered issue entries were dated 27 October) were read. No separate web search was run, to keep the blindness rule clean.

All category 1-12 votes are neutral by design except the Trend structure votes, which follow the computed structure reads (the dollar's 1H uptrend; weekly uptrends for ES/RTY; weekly downtrends for ZN/GC); the mechanical Market structure category carries its own direction.

newsLog.event: FOMC begins its two-day meeting; a hold is widely expected, with markets focused on December guidance and hike pricing. US futures roughly flat pre-market ahead of Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon earnings.
newsLog.numbers: Fed funds 3.75-4.00%; ~90% odds of hold; S&P E-minis ~+0.05%, Dow E-minis ~+0.14%
newsLog.reaction: Muted, range-bound futures as traders wait for Wednesday's statement and guidance on further hikes.

newsLog.event: Oil holds near six-month highs after slipping Monday; Trump says it is 'getting to be decision time' on an Iran deal versus resuming attacks, while Houthi strikes on Saudi infrastructure keep supply risk elevated.
newsLog.numbers: Brent settled $110.17 Mon (-1.4%) after $116.72 Fri (highest settle since April); WTI ~$101 per CNBC
newsLog.reaction: Oil volatile on headline risk; elevated crude feeds inflation and hike fears, a headwind for bonds and equities.

newsLog.event: Stocks close higher for a second day as chip stocks rally; Nasdaq leads ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision and Microsoft/Alphabet earnings.
newsLog.reaction: Broad tech/semi rally pushed Nasdaq to the day's biggest gain; Dow roughly flat as market positions ahead of Wednesday's FOMC decision and Big Tech earnings.

newsLog.event: Nvidia to invest $3B in Meta and expand AI-model collaboration; Meta plans to raise up to $95B in equity to fund AI buildout. Anthropic's IPO prospectus also revives AI-stock enthusiasm.
newsLog.numbers: Nvidia investment: $3B; Meta equity raise: up to $95B
newsLog.reaction: Fed fresh AI-financing optimism, helping lift chip and AI-adjacent names into the close.

newsLog.event: Mixed earnings slate: Coca-Cola and UPS beat and raised guidance; Robinhood revenue rose on options/event-contract trading; Whirlpool missed and cut its outlook.
newsLog.numbers: KO adj. EPS $0.91, rev $13.4B; UPS FY revenue guide raised to ~$92.6B (from ~$91.2B); HOOD revenue +12% (crypto rev -55%)
newsLog.reaction: UPS +~2% on guidance raise; KO higher despite flat North American volume; Whirlpool fell on guidance cut.
newsLog.vsExp: KO and UPS beat estimates; Whirlpool missed
